---- Fachhochschule des Mittelstands (FHM) Refund Policy: Tuition Fee (2019-06-20) ----

 

Before starting a study program (Pre-Studies Program, Pre-Studies Program Professional, Pre-Studies Program Professional Med & MMA, Bachelor Program and Master Program), the international participant of any study program is requested to pay the tuition fee. An invoice is submitted.

The international participant may apply for the refund of the tuition fee in cases mentioned below:

1.     The FHM refunds 100% of the fees charged if the visa of the participant has been rejected and therefore entry is not possible. An administration fee of 150 € will be charged.

2.     The FHM refunds 70% of the fees charged if the applicant does not attend the interview at the embassy.

3.     The FHM refunds 50% of the fees charged if the visa has been issued and the applicant cancels his participation in the program until four weeks before the start of the program.

4.     The FHM refunds 70% of the fees charged if the visa has been issued and the applicant cancels his participation in the program on ground of ill health. In this case a medical certificate is needed.

5.     The FHM does not refund, if the FHM does not have a formal notice of termination of the study program 14 days before the start of the program.

6.     The international participant ensures the bank details he/she provides are correct. FHM is not responsible for payments made to incorrect accounts provided by international participants.

7.     Additional agreements are not accepted.

8.     Legal venue is Bielefeld.

---- Fachhochschule des Mittelstands (FHM) Refund Policy: Tuition Fee (2019-06-20) ----

 

Before starting a study program (Pre-Studies Program, Pre-Studies Program Professional, Pre-Studies Program Professional Med & MMA, Bachelor Program and Master Program), the international participant of any study program is requested to pay the tuition fee. An invoice is submitted.

The international participant may apply for the refund of the tuition fee in cases mentioned below:

1.     The FHM refunds 100% of the fees charged if the visa of the participant has been rejected and therefore entry is not possible. An administration fee of 150 € will be charged.

2.     The FHM refunds 70% of the fees charged if the applicant does not attend the interview at the embassy.

3.     The FHM refunds 50% of the fees charged if the visa has been issued and the applicant cancels his participation in the program until four weeks before the start of the program.

4.     The FHM refunds 70% of the fees charged if the visa has been issued and the applicant cancels his participation in the program on ground of ill health. In this case a medical certificate is needed.

5.     The FHM does not refund, if the FHM does not have a formal notice of termination of the study program 14 days before the start of the program.

6.     The international participant ensures the bank details he/she provides are correct. FHM is not responsible for payments made to incorrect accounts provided by international participants.

7.     Additional agreements are not accepted.

8.     Legal venue is Bielefeld.
